areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Aligned specific objectives and indicators, but bioeconomy value chains relate only indirectly to creative economy and traditional cultures; low impact.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Central objective with aligned components, indicators, targets and significant resources; high impact; efficient solutions though not shown to be innovative.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Comprehensive adaptation and mitigation approach, but low impact given the share of resources devoted to it.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: Actions affect sustainable rural and extractive productivity, but low impact given limited resources; efficient but not shown innovative.

areas.name: Poverty
areas.reason: No actions directly addressing food insecurity or poverty; bioeconomy and conservation effects on livelihoods are only indirect.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: No actions specifically for inclusion or protection of vulnerable people; productive-inclusion effects are indirect.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Gender inequality is acknowledged but no action in scope specifically addresses it.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: No initiatives addressing the specifics of indigenous, quilombola or traditional communities; effects are indirect.
